# Beautifood

> Restaurant queueing, ordering and reservations. Guests (and their AI agents) can browse menus with allergens, check live queues across branches, join a walk-in queue, preorder while waiting, and book tables.

## For AI agents

- MCP server (Streamable HTTP, JSON-RPC, no auth for guest tools): POST /mcp
  - Guest tools: find_restaurants, get_menu, ask_menu_assistant, queue_status, join_queue, check_ticket, cancel_ticket, booking_availability, create_booking
  - Merchant tools (send `Authorization: Bearer bf_pat_…` created in the staff console under Team → AI agent access): merchant_overview, merchant_queue, merchant_sales_report, merchant_set_sold_out
- REST API description: /openapi.json

## Rules for agents

- Confirm party size, name and time with the user before joining a queue or booking.
- Allergen information is provided by each restaurant; tell users with severe allergies to confirm with staff.
- Ticket and booking links contain private tokens: share them only with the user who made the request.

## Key REST endpoints

- GET /api/public/directory — all branches with live queue length and wait estimates
- GET /api/public/branches/{branch}/menu — menu (prices in minor units, allergens, dietary tags, stories)
- GET /api/public/branches/{branch}/status — live queue by party size
- POST /api/public/branches/{branch}/queue — join the queue {partySize, name, email?}
- GET /api/public/branches/{branch}/availability?day=YYYY-MM-DD&party=N — booking slots
- POST /api/public/branches/{branch}/bookings — book {name, partySize, slotStart(ms), email?}
- POST /api/public/branches/{branch}/assistant — ask the menu assistant {messages:[{role,content}]}
